decision: Use content-addressed cache keys for generated artifacts
reason:
Path-based cache keys are easy to compute but can reuse stale output when source content changes without a path change. Content-addressed keys would make cache identity follow the actual inputs across builders.

The initial discussion lacked evidence that more than one generator needed this contract, so the decision was dispositioned as watch. Reconsider it only when another session reports the same stale-artifact failure or requires shared cache identity.
tradeoff: Hashing inputs costs computation and requires every generator to agree on canonical input serialization.

facets.label: Watch trigger
facets.text: Wake when another generator needs shared content-based cache identity.

facets.label: Potential scope
facets.text: Could coordinate multiple artifact builders if the failure recurs.
